errors.evidence: The description for the pink (described as purple) line is an incorrect copy of the green line's description. The pink line actually starts at about 0.03 and peaks at about 0.13, not 0.04 and 0.15 respectively.

errors.text_span: starts at a similarity of approximately 0.11
errors.evidence: The en&en line starts at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, not 0.11.
For the en&en line, the value at layer 21 is approximately 0.08, not 0.12.
The final value for the en&en line is approximately 0.44, but this occurs after layer 22, not at layer 22. The value at layer 22 is approximately 0.1.

errors.text_span: The en&es line begins at approximately 0.09
errors.evidence: The en&es line starts at approximately 0.06 at layer 0, not 0.09.
The peak for the en&es line at layer 6 is approximately 0.24, which is visibly lower than the en&en peak (around 0.26). Stating 0.26 is an overestimation.
The final value for the en&es line is approximately 0.27, not 0.32. Additionally, this value is reached after layer 22, not at layer 22.

errors.text_span: The en&el line starts at about 0.07
errors.evidence: The en&el line starts at approximately 0.04 at layer 0, not 0.07.
The peak for the en&el line at layer 6 is approximately 0.15, not 0.17.

The final value for the en&el line is approximately 0.30. While 0.31 is a close approximation, the description incorrectly states this value is at layer 22. The value at layer 22 is approximately 0.05.
The peak for the en&bn line at layer 6 is approximately 0.10, not 0.18. This is a significant overestimation.
The final value for the en&bn line is approximately 0.29, not 0.32. Additionally, this value is reached after layer 22; the value at layer 22 is approximately 0.05.
The line representing the 'en&bn' language pair is pink or magenta, not purple.
The sharp increase in similarity for all language pairs occurs from layer 22 to the final data point (at layer 23), not between layers 21 and 22. The values are still relatively low at layer 22.

errors.text_span: reaching the highest similarity of approximately 0.43 at layer 22
errors.evidence: The 'en&en' pair reaches a similarity of approximately 0.43 at the final data point (layer 23), not at layer 22. At layer 22, its similarity is much lower, at about 0.12.

errors.text_span: while the en&bn pair remains consistently lower in similarity throughout the layers
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. While the 'en&bn' pair is lower for most of the layers, at the final data point (layer 23), its similarity value (~0.30) is higher than that of the 'en&es' pair (~0.27).

errors.text_span: The en&es and en&el pairs show similar trends
errors.evidence: While all pairs show a broadly similar U-shaped trend with a peak at layer 6, stating that 'en&es' and 'en&el' specifically show similar trends is an over-generalization. The 'en&es' line is consistently higher than the 'en&el' line for most of the graph until the very end, where 'en&el' surpasses it.
